newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 22.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Friday:
- The U.S. Transportation Department will allow automobile drivers to disconnect their airbags and manufacturers to make them inflate more slowly.
- Federal prosecutors arrested 29 people including Brooklyn's former head tax collector for charges of tax fraud.
- Russian and Western scientists said Russia has been without photo reconnaissance satellites for nearly two months.
- U.N. governments and relief agencies disagreed over the central question of how many Rwandan refugees are still trapped in neighboring Zaire.
- U.S. President Bill Clinton's administration is on the verge of relaxing a two-decades-old policy to keep nuclear weapons out of the hands of terrorists and rogue states.
